## Learning goals

- I can use colour for emphasis without making colour the only cue.
- I can measure text and graphic contrast.
- I can test the final screen, print, or fabricated result and revise it.

::: {.callout-note}
The visual examples come from the [Graphics Accommodation Guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AfDpLSJQtKy7YUMdwL8-BBR81NTv9Ck_cyzQ4pA2Hk4/edit). WCAG 2.2 ratios are added so students have a measurable test as well as a visual comparison.
:::
